title: Mechanistic-Closure Real-World Validation Freeze
scientific_question: Given candidate regulatory relations supplied by an upstream discovery layer, can they be closed into a context-specific mechanism whose predicted perturbation-induced state transition agrees with an independently measured transcriptomic response?

project_boundary.TopoMIEG_FM: assembles supplied candidate relations into a local mechanistic system and evaluates state-transition closure

baseline_state.use: independent non-perturbational K562 baseline expression state

candidate_relations.outcome_overlap: none by design; perturbation outcomes are not used to define the relations

heldout_response.study: Replogle et al., Cell 2022, genome-scale K562 CRISPRi Perturb-seq
heldout_response.processed_source: official GWPS processed K562 genome-scale pseudobulk / expression response data
heldout_response.scope: K562 genome-wide screen; all expressed genes targeted
heldout_response.policy: Perturbation-specific downstream response vectors remain unopened by the model-development process until all eligible-source predictions and their SHA256 manifest are frozen.

eligible_source_rule: source gene is perturbed in the held-out K562 screen
source gene is a DoRothEA TF with confidence-A/B outgoing relations
source and target genes are expressed in independent K562 baseline data
at least 20 evaluable downstream target genes remain after gene-ID intersection
mechanism_construction.node_set: V_s = source TF plus all expressed confidence-A/B direct targets of source s
mechanism_construction.edge_set: E_s = every confidence-A/B signed DoRothEA interaction whose source and target both lie in V_s; this induced subgraph allows interactions among source targets and therefore permits local feedback/closure
mechanism_construction.edge_weight: unit magnitude; sign from DoRothEA mode-of-regulation; confidence A/B used only for inclusion, not magnitude
mechanism_construction.operator_orientation: W[i,j] is effect of regulator j on target i
mechanism_construction.operator_scaling: rescale W to spectral norm 0.30 when nonzero

baseline_state_mapping.expression_summary: gene-level pseudobulk log1p expression from independent K562 baseline data
baseline_state_mapping.transform: within each mechanism node set, rank baseline expression; map ranks monotonically to (-1,1) using x_obs_i = 2*(rank_i-0.5)/n - 1, then clip to [-0.95,0.95]
baseline_state_mapping.interpretation: baseline state is an anchored boundary condition rather than a fitted validation endpoint; external validation concerns the held-out perturbational transition

heldout_observed_response.representation: for each eligible source perturbation, observed pseudobulk expression response relative to non-targeting controls
heldout_observed_response.evaluation_genes: genes in V_s excluding the perturbed source and requiring presence in the held-out expression matrix

comparators.primary_simple_comparator: one-step signed-edge propagation Delta_linear = -0.50 * W @ e_source, evaluated on the same genes
comparators.negative_control: degree- and sign-count-preserving target rewiring within each local mechanism; 100 rewires per source, seed 20261107

primary_metrics.per_perturbation: Spearman correlation rho_s between Delta_pred and held-out Delta_obs across evaluation genes
primary_metrics.aggregate: median rho_s across all eligible source perturbations
primary_metrics.co_primary_gain: median over sources of rho_equilibrium - rho_one_step

hard_GO: at least 30 eligible K562 source perturbations satisfy the prespecified relation-coverage rule
all predictions are frozen and SHA256-bound before perturbation response vectors are opened
bootstrap 95% lower CI of median rho_equilibrium is > 0
bootstrap 95% lower CI of median(rho_equilibrium - rho_one_step) is > 0
median rho_equilibrium is greater than the median of each source's rewired-network null distribution in at least 70% of eligible perturbations
all fixed-point solves used for the primary analysis satisfy residual <= 1e-10 and effective spectral radius <= 0.35
secondary_metrics: per-source Pearson correlation on response vectors
sign concordance among the top 20% largest absolute held-out responses within each source
cosine similarity of predicted and observed response vectors
program-level concordance using Hallmark gene-set scores, evaluated only after gene-level primary metrics are frozen
source-level relationship between baseline closure geometry and perturbation predictivity

interpretable_case.predicted_transition: BCL11A down; HBG1/HBG2 up; HbF program increases
interpretable_case.role: interpretable biological demonstration; not the blinded scalable primary gate

external_generalization.resource: 2026 primary human CD4+ T-cell genome-scale Perturb-seq
external_generalization.paper_A_restriction: exclude Crohn/IBD-tagged analyses from primary Paper-A claims

leakage_rules: Do not use Replogle perturbation response vectors to select sources, edges, signs, weights, node sets, hyperparameters, or solver parameters.
Do not use perturbation-derived differential-expression significance to filter primary evaluation genes.
Do not use GEARS/scGPT/other models trained on the same held-out perturbation outcomes as discovery inputs.
DoRothEA confidence A/B and signs are frozen before outcome access.
Only after prediction_manifest.tsv and SHA256SUMS are frozen may held-out response vectors be parsed for scoring.
No post-outcome retuning or source exclusion is permitted except predeclared technical invalidity (missing identifiers or solver failure), which remains in the denominator and is reported.

claim_authorization.authorization_requires: successful prospective K562 primary gate; BCL11A case may support interpretation but cannot rescue a failed primary gate
